cpu_followup.git_commit: not recorded in this receipt; source hashes and same binary identify the measured implementation
cpu_followup.policy: historical size-admitted assistance, before policy selector/Progress; current API must explicitly use Always to approximate this mode
cpu_followup.process_cpu_accounting: RLIMIT_CPU disabled after calibration demonstrated stale process-CPU clocks when that limit was set; external wall timeout remains

timing_contract.median_us: Median of five warm batch means from one retained compiled program; each batch contains 1..64 checked queries
timing_contract.preparation: Three batch means per phase with 1..8 iterations: parse+destroy and program build+destroy, both measured separately from recognition
timing_contract.first_query_us: First return after construction; assisted workers are constructed with their program. No helper drain or deliberate cache flush is included
timing_contract.first_parse_us: Initial common Crank AST parse; Marpa uses the same AST converted into its grammar
timing_contract.first_build_us: Initial native/assisted/Marpa program construction; assisted worker-pool construction is included
timing_contract.first_total_us: Initial common AST parse plus program construction plus owned-input preparation where applicable plus first query, measured as one interval; excludes post-return drain
timing_contract.cpu_median_us: Process CPU during warm batch windows includes foreground and helpers; a helper tail can outlive a window, so use warm_cpu_through_idle_per_query_us for complete amortized work
timing_contract.warm_cpu_through_idle_per_query_us: Total process CPU from before five contiguous warm batches through a single final wait_idle, divided by timed queries; includes every warm helper task and phase counter/timer overhead
timing_contract.tails: First, warm, and diagnostic idle-tail fields measure an explicit maintenance wait outside full_match. Pool snapshots are cumulative counters across queries; subtract phase endpoints for phase work
timing_contract.owned_input: assist2_owned prepares one shared immutable subject outside repeated matching. Its initial allocation/copy cost is recorded separately and included in first_total_us; other assisted modes charge admitted string_view copies inside each query
timing_contract.counters: One separate diagnostic query after warm helpers are idle; pool snapshots are cumulative across first, warm, and diagnostic phases, while assistance counters describe only the diagnostic query
timing_contract.scope: Boolean full-string byte recognition; no parse trees, captures, semantic validation, tokenizer, or streaming prefix API
timing_contract.limits: Crank state/work exhaustion, compile rejection, allocation failure, and external wall timeout remain distinct non-decisions with no match verdict or speedup ratio
timing_contract.sequential: native is the existing native core with disabled assistance specialization; assist1 is the wrapper with no helpers; native_indexed retains the prior synchronous input-filter wrapper with scan work charged against the original query caps
timing_contract.parallel: assist2/4/8 retain the existing authoritative native matcher with 1/3/7 optional private helpers. Matching never waits for helpers; consecutive warm queries may decline assistance if the pool is busy
timing_contract.assistance: Default 1024-byte admission threshold and independent one-million helper-step allowance. Native state/work caps are unchanged. Helpers publish only monotone atomic negative certificates
timing_contract.marpa: Direct pinned libmarpa C recognition with Leo enabled; no Perl wrapper, extra Crank prefilter, lexer, or tokenization
timing_contract.affinity: Every child receives the same up-to-eight-CPU mask and runs alone; CPU affinity and cgroup quota are recorded separately
timing_contract.ordering: Seeded shuffle of case/replicate blocks, followed by seeded shuffle of modes within each block
timing_contract.summary: Median of fresh-process medians; only groups with all replicates completed receive ratios. marpa_speedup = Marpa / variant, so values above one favor the variant
timing_contract.excluded: Process launch, case construction, oracle validation, diagnostic counters, and JSON serialization

progress_comparison.retained_difference: Progress became API default; scheduling-sensitive policy tests corrected; measured policies were explicit
progress_comparison.rlimit_cpu: not applied: earlier experiment observed clock-accounting distortion

counter_semantics: Assistance counters describe one separate diagnostic query; pool snapshots are cumulative across first/warm/diagnostic phases. Subtract warm_idle minus warm_before for phase totals. helpers_admitted or max worker ceiling is not peak concurrent execution.
causal_scope: Native and assisted modes are in the same historical executable, same expression/input/Boolean observer and native caps. Helpers have additional bounded work. The foreground consumes a root rejection; no native-limit rescue occurred in selected rows. Compare current explicit native core with current AssistedProgram for new tests, not arbitrary Auto dispatcher.
experimental_scope: Historical narrowly selected rejection wins; extra threads are optional, many survivors or already-cheap cases slow down. No current-release timing claim is made.
